description: This file implements the RemoteGateKeeperDevice class, which handles communication with a gatekeeper service over a shared file descriptor channel. It includes methods for enrolling, verifying, and managing user data related to gatekeeper authentication, utilizing Android hardware security tokens and password handles.

classes.name: RemoteGateKeeperDevice
classes.description: A class that manages remote interactions with the gatekeeper service, including enrollment and verification of credentials, over a shared file descriptor channel.

methods.name: enroll
methods.description: Handles enrollment of a new password or biometric credential for a user, sending the request over the channel and processing the response.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies a provided password or biometric against the enrolled data, returning the result and a hardware authentication token if successful.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Unimplemented method intended to delete a user from the gatekeeper system.

methods.name: deleteAllUsers
methods.description: Unimplemented method intended to delete all users from the gatekeeper system.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a request to the gatekeeper service and receives a response, handling serialization and deserialization.
